agents.name: Schedule an Intro Call
agents.description: Books a 30-minute intro call on Jake Gaylor's real calendar. Ask about availability to get open slots, then send `BOOK: <slot ISO time> | <your email> | <your name> | <optional note>`. Bookings are pending until Jake Gaylor confirms; the booker receives the outcome by email. Humans can book directly at the booking page returned with the slots.
